//onCreate: OPTIONAL. Command run when you click ⚡, so the hand-off reaches an agent instead of waiting for one to read the queue file. Empty (the default) spawns nothing. A string runs through the shell; an array is spawned directly with no shell. Context arrives as env vars — FLOW_QUEUE_FILE, FLOW_SESSION_FILE, FLOW_ACK_FILE, FLOW_PROJECT_ROOT, FLOW_QUEUE_DEPTH, FLOW_ENQUEUED, FLOW_SCENARIOS — so nothing needs quoting into the command. One runs at a time: clicking ⚡ again while it works does not start a second agent. Disable for one run with `record --no-hooks`.
